verdict.rationale: Superset supports bulk operations across many items via CLI/SDK/MCP for scripted creation, triage, or cleanup of tasks across projects, orchestration skills to fan out work across many worktrees, and community evidence of running 40-50 concurrent agent sessions across repos. missing for 10: independent benchmark of true 'bulk' API operations (e.g., batch endpoints) rather than iterative scripting, and no third-party audit of reliability at very large scale beyond the one HN anecdote.
